## Subscription

Recurring commercial agreement: linked Customer, plan name, price (base `AmountWithCurrency`), billing cycle enum (monthly / yearly), start date, status enum (trial / active / paused / canceled).

```ts
import { Subscription } from '../subscription';
```

**Non-goals:** a Plan catalog card (plan is a string until a Plan block exists), proration, automatic invoice generation (that is a tool, not the record).

**2026-08-10 deltas:** computed `renewalDate` (next cycle boundary after today; only while `trial`/`active`). A `contract` link is deliberately deferred until the Contract block exists (v1.1). Examples cover active, trial ($0 price), and canceled (renewalDate empty).
